title: Exact universal 5/14 Johnson all-rank atom-TV theorem
status: complete traditional proof with independently replayed exact finite certificates; no external referee or Lean claim
theorems: For every n>=6, C_n^all=C_{n,floor(n/2)}=5/14 exactly, attained by rational four-conjugacy-class measures
For all n>=1, C_n^all=0 (n<=2), 1/3 (n=3,4,5), 5/14 (n>=6); small cases import prior proved natural and edge action theorems
For any faithful G<=S_n matching its uniform group's full subset-image marginals at every rank, every group atom has sharp universal upper coefficient 5/14
All equality directions have positive support on identity/four-cycle and negative support on transpositions/two disjoint three-cycles (or reversed); class masses are rigid
The same sharp 5/14 inequality at the identity holds under the weaker invariant-subset-count expectation constraints alone

proof.tail_certification: Both duals satisfy a strict rational sum(|alpha_i|*(q_i^2+(1-q_i)^2)^r)<7/50, with analytic power-mean domination for all larger cycles.
proof.sharp_primal: 5 U_identity + 9 U_one-4cycle = 12 U_one-transposition + 2 U_two-disjoint-3cycles, at the level of every subset-image orbital; normalize as 5/14,9/14 and 6/7,1/7.

reproduction: From repository root run each of the six scripts above with python3; they use only standard-library integer and Fraction arithmetic.
warnings: No external human peer review or Lean proof is claimed
No world-first novelty or mathematical priority claim is made
Two explicit duals are distinct certificates for the same theorem; the finite computational parts are fully enumerated exact integer assertions, not numerical optimization
